title: teline linifolia subsp. rosmarinifolia
intro: Teline linifolia subsp. rosmarinifolia, commonly known as Rockrose, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It is used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and respiratory issues, showcasing its potential as a natural remedy for stress and sleep disorders. The therapeutic actions of Teline linifolia subsp. rosmarinifolia include sedative, anxiolytic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which contribute to its calming and soothing properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and offer a range of health benefits when used appropriately.
